hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 identified through ROM

inputs.name: NOR FIT sector image
inputs.revision: S31 firmware, kernel and memory-disk root FIT

scenario: Using the vendor ROM and official esptool 5.6.0, write the selected SPL and FIT sector ranges to the onboard NOR and independently verify each complete range using the ROM digest.
expected: The ROM verifies both written ranges against their respective sector images.
observed: The write completed for [0x2000, 0x10000) and [0x20000, 0x526000). A separate verify-flash operation reported a matching digest for each full range. The prior NOR backup was retained.
limits: The independent check used ROM digests for the two selected ranges; it is not a byte readback of the full NOR.
This record establishes write and ROM digest verification only; normal power-on boot requires separate evidence.
The event log, backup contents and device identifiers remain private.
